title: Manager - Accounting
jobDescription:
<p><strong>Manager
- Accounting</strong></p> <p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p> <p>Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and <strong>cut carbon</strong>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We deliver this through three comprehensive solutions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Utility Bill Management:</strong> Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.</li> <li><strong>Energy Procurement Advisory</strong>: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .</li> <li><strong>Sustainability Reporting</strong> — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.</li> </ul> <p>Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant with 3–4 years of post-qualification experience to manage accounting operations and ensure accurate financial reporting, timely month-end closures, statutory compliance, payroll accounting, audit coordination, and continuous improvement of accounting processes.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Accounting Operations &amp; Financial Reporting</strong></h3> <ul> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Own and manage accounting activities including accounts payable, general ledger accounting, reconciliations, accruals, fixed assets, and month-end/year-end closing activities.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Review journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules to ensure accuracy and compliance with accounting policies.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Ensure timely month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close processes.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Prepare and review financial statements, management reports, and MIS reporting packs.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Analyse financial data and provide insights on trends, variances, and key financial information.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, company policies, and internal controls.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Payroll Accounting &amp; Employee Cost Management</strong></h3> <ul> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Oversee payroll accounting activities, including review of payroll inputs, payroll processing, and payroll-related accounting entries.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Ensure accurate recording of payroll expenses, employee benefits, reimbursements, and statutory deductions.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Coordinate with HR and payroll consultants to resolve payroll-related accounting issues.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Review employee-related provisions and ensure appropriate accounting treatment.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Statutory Compliance &amp; Regulatory Matters</strong></h3> <ul> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, and other applicable statutory requirements.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Review statutory compliance workings prepared by internal teams/consultants.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Coordinate with external consultants for regulatory updates and compliance requirements.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Audit &amp; Internal Controls</strong></h3> <ul> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Lead coordination with statutory auditors, tax consultants, and internal auditors.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Ensure timely preparation and submission of audit schedules, supporting documents, and management responses.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Strengthen internal controls and identify opportunities for process improvements.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Process Improvement &amp; Automation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Identify opportunities for automation and improvement in accounting processes.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Drive efficient usage of ERP systems and accounting tools.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Support implementation of new processes, systems, and reporting requirements.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What Will Help You Succeed</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Must-Haves</strong></h3> <ul> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 3–4 years of post-qualification experience in accounting and finance operations.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and month-end close processes.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Experience managing payroll accounting and statutory compliance activities.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Experience in handling audits and working with external auditors/consultants.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Advanced proficiency in MS Excel.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Strong ownership and accountability.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Attention to detail with a business-oriented mindset.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Ability to independently manage accounting operations.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Ability to identify issues and drive solutions.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Nice-to-Haves</strong></h3> <ul> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Experience working with ERP systems such as Oracle Net Suite, SAP, or similar platforms.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Experience with accounting software such as Quick Books.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Exposure to multinational/global finance operations.</li> </ul> <p><br><br><br></p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation based on market standards&nbsp;</li> <li>We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy</li> <li>Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits</li> <ul> <li>Flexible Leave Policy</li> <li>Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose</li> </ul> </ul> <ul> <li>We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)</li> <li>Flexible Benefit Plan</li> <li>Awards and Bonus</li> <li>Annual performance cycle</li> <li>Quarterly engagement activities</li> <li><a href="https://www.arcadia.com/assets/Engineering_Strategy_and_Values_V4.pdf">A supportive culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency</a></li> </ul> <p><strong>Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.</strong></p> <p>Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Thank you</p></div>

title: Senior Data Analyst - Revenue Ops
jobDescription: <p><strong>Who We Are :</strong></p> <p>Arcadia is the technology company empowering energy innovators and consumers to fight the climate crisis. Our software and APIs are revolutionizing an industry held back by outdated systems and institutions by creating unprecedented access to the data and clean energy needed to make a decarbonized energy grid possible.</p> <p>In 2014, Arcadia set out on its mission to break the fossil fuel monopoly and since then we have been knocking down the institutional barriers to unlock decarbonization. To date, we have connected hundreds of thousands of consumers and small businesses with high-quality clean energy options. Fast forward to today, and now, we’re thinking even bigger. We have launched Arc, an industry-defining Saa S platform that empowers developers and energy innovators to deliver their own custom, personalized energy experiences, accelerating the transformation of the industry from an analog energy system into a digitized information network.</p> <p>Tackling one of the world’s biggest challenges requires out-of-the-box thinking &amp; diverse perspectives. We’re building a team of individuals from different backgrounds, industries, &amp; educational experiences. If you share our passion for ushering in the era of the clean electron, we look forward to learning what you would uniquely bring to Arcadia! Visit www.arcadia.com.</p> <p>HQ: Greenwood Village, Colorado</p> <p>$1.5B valuation: $380 million funding to date</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for multiple Senior Data Analysts to join our operations, marketing, product, and corporate finance data analytics groups. The senior analyst will develop key metrics to measure customer health and company performance, enable business users to extensively self-serve on data, provide ad hoc query support, and identify business insights to optimize our biggest cost drivers.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build critical reports to execute critical, data-based operations</li> <li>Develop key metrics to measure customer health and company performance, with an eye toward your assigned stakeholder and the rest of the business</li> <li>Build strong, proactive relationships with key stakeholder counterparts, including helping them define their needs and scope requirements</li> <li>Provide varying, ad hoc query support as needed to unblock active business challenges</li> <li>Be a subject matter expert on all key business data and help ensure consistent use of that data by all analytics teams, including via documentation and peer mentorship</li> <li>As one of the first senior analytics hires, help establish the culture and processes for Arcadia’s analytics team&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><br><br><br><br></p> <p><strong>What will help you succeed</strong></p> <p><strong>Must-haves:</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>5+ years in data analytics, business analytics, data science, statistics, or related field</li> <li>Consistent record of proactive exploratory data analysis, distilling actionable insights and recommendations, and telling a story with data</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills, including with senior stakeholders and with analytics peers</li> <li>Strong knowledge of SQL</li> <li>Fundamental quantitative statistical skills like calculating statistical significance</li> <li>Comfortable managing a combination of fast-paced ad hoc work and long-term projects</li> <li>Extensive experience BI tools like Looker or Tableau</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Nice-to-haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Basics of Python or R</li> <li>Familiarity with dbt or other data modeling systems and techniques</li> <li>Experience working with business and operational teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation based on market standards</li> <li>We are working on a hybrid model</li> <li>Apart from Fixed Base Salary , the candidates are eligible for following benefits</li> <ul> <li>Flexible Leave Policy</li> <li>Office Located in the heart of the City in case you need to step in for any purpose</li> <li>Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)</li> <li>Quarterly team engagement activities and rewards &amp; recognitions</li> <li>L&amp;D programs to foster professional growth</li> </ul> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.</strong></p> <p>Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. While we are currently unable to consider candidates who will require visa sponsorship, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates eligible to work in Chennai, India.</p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Thank you</p></div>

title: Senior Security Engineer
jobDescription: <p>Senior Security Engineer (Security Operations)</p> <p>Who we are</p> <p>Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale. Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and cut carbon.</p> <p>We deliver this through three comprehensive solutions:</p> <p>● Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.</p> <p>● Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .</p> <p>● Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.</p> <p>Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.&nbsp;</p> <p>Job summary</p> <p>As a Senior Security Engineer, you’ll be the technical anchor of Arcadia’s security operations function, leading the daily defense of our endpoints, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. You’ll operate with significant autonomy and strong collaboration across our global team, drive initiatives end to end, and partner directly with security leadership in the U.S. to mature our detection, response, and vulnerability management programs. You’ll also support our SOC 2 Type II program by owning the technical controls within your scope.</p> <p>This person will report to the Senior Manager of Security in the U.S., with strong local collaboration in Chennai, India. You’ll work as part of a single global security team operating with consistent expectations and shared standards across the globe.</p> <p>What we’re looking for</p> <p>We’re seeking a Senior Security Engineer based in Chennai, India with 5 to 8 years of experience in security operations, endpoint security, and cloud security. This is an Individual Contributor role at the Senior (L4) level, anchored in Sec Ops with expected contributions to security engineering work. The ideal candidate is technically deep, operationally disciplined, and comfortable driving programs end to end with light oversight. You should be equally at ease tuning an EDR detection, leading a vulnerability remediation effort with key stakeholders, and leading security incident response. You’ll bring strong judgment, clear written communication, and the ability to translate technical risk into business terms.</p> <p>This role goes beyond reactive security analyst work and includes leadership of detection, response, and engineering initiatives. You’ll be expected to shape how Arcadia’s security operations function evolves, mentor teammates, and contribute to the broader security strategy.</p> <p>At Arcadia, we value demonstrated experience over certifications. Whatever certifications you hold or don’t hold, what matters most is the depth of your hands-on security work and the impact you’ve had on the teams and programs you’ve supported.</p> <p>What you’ll do</p> <p>● Own and operate Arcadia’s endpoint security program on Crowd Strike, including detection tuning, response workflows, and policy management across Windows and mac OS</p> <p>● Lead vulnerability management end to end: scanning cadence, risk-based prioritization, and partnering with key stakeholders to drive remediation to closure</p> <p>● Partner with engineering teams to strengthen cloud security in AWS over time, contributing to identity hygiene, configuration review, baseline assessments, and detection coverage as the program matures</p> <p>● Serve as the response lead for security incidents: owning triage, investigation, containment, and post-incident review in coordination with senior security leadership</p> <p>● Build and maintain detection content, response runbooks, and operational metrics that demonstrate program effectiveness</p> <p>● Support Arcadia’s SOC 2 Type II program by owning the technical controls within your scope, producing audit evidence, and partnering with the GRC function on control design and testing</p> <p>● Partner with the global IT team on identity, device management, and email security to ensure security best practices are operationalized</p> <p>● Contribute to security engineering initiatives when the work calls for it: including tooling, automation, and infrastructure improvements that scale Sec Ops capabilities</p> <p>● Mentor teammates and elevate the technical depth of the security team</p> <p>● Contribute to security roadmap planning and represent security operations in cross-functional initiatives</p> <p>What will help you succeed</p> <p>● 5 to 8 years of experience in security operations, endpoint security, or cloud security roles</p> <p>● Demonstrated ownership of EDR platforms, with Crowd Strike preferred (Sentinel One, Defender, or equivalent also acceptable), including detection tuning and response workflows</p> <p>● Working knowledge of AWS security fundamentals, including IAM, logging and detection (Cloud Trail, Guard Duty, or equivalent), and common misconfiguration patterns, with the ability to grow this practice in partnership with engineering</p> <p>● Practical experience leading or significantly contributing to security incidents from detection through resolution</p> <p>● Working knowledge of vulnerability management programs at scale, including prioritization frameworks and remediation partnership with cross-functional teams</p> <p>● Familiarity with SOC 2 Type II or comparable control frameworks, with the ability to operate technical controls and produce audit evidence</p> <p>● Ability to operate independently, drive projects to completion, and exercise sound judgment with light oversight</p> <p>● Fluent written and spoken English. Daily collaboration across our global team is conducted in English, including incident response, technical documentation, code review, and meetings</p> <p>● Availability to overlap with U.S. working hours for collaboration meetings, with overlap typically ending no later than 8:30 PM IST</p> <p>Nice-to-have</p> <p>● Proficiency in at least one scripting language for automation and tooling</p> <p>● Experience with identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, or equivalent) and SSO/MFA hardening</p> <p>● Exposure to detection-as-code workflows, SIEM tuning, or building security automations</p> <p>● Experience working in a globally distributed security team</p> <p>Benefits</p> <p>● Competitive compensation based on market standards</p> <p>● We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy</p> <p>● Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits</p> <p>○ Flexible Leave Policy</p> <p>○ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose</p> <p>● We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.</p> <p>● Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)</p> <p>● Flexible Benefit Plan</p> <p>● Awards and Bonus</p> <p>● Annual performance cycle</p> <p>● Quarterly engagement activities</p> <p>● A supportive workplace culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency</p> <p>Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.&nbsp;</p> <p>Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Thank you</p></div>

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobDescription: <h1><strong>Staff Site Reliability Engineer</strong></h1> <h2><strong>Who we are:</strong></h2> <p>Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.</p> <p>Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and <strong>cut carbon</strong>.</p> <p>We deliver this through three comprehensive solutions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Utility Bill Management:</strong> Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.</li> <li><strong>Energy Procurement Advisory</strong>: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .</li> <li><strong>Sustainability Reporting</strong> — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.</li> </ul> <p>Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.</p> <h1><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></h1> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Staff Site Reliability Engineer (L4)</strong> to join our SRE/Platform Engineering team in India. This is a senior technical leadership role — not people management, but engineering leadership through execution, mentorship, and architectural ownership.</p> <p>Our India SRE team is growing, and this role is central to that growth. As we scale, we need a technical anchor in the India timezone who can independently own multi-week SRE projects from problem statement to production, make sound architectural decisions under ambiguity, and elevate the team around them. You will be the person engineers lean on for design reviews, debugging escalations, and “how should we approach this?” conversations. You’ll bring the depth and experience to drive execution autonomously in the India timezone while collaborating closely with US-based SRE leadership on roadmap priorities, incident response, and platform strategy.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who doesn’t wait for direction — you identify reliability gaps, propose solutions, build consensus, and ship.</p> <p>Our infrastructure is primarily AWS-based, managed by Terraform and Cloud Formation, and deployed using CI/CD best practices. In your application, please include a link to Git Hub or another place where your code is published, though we understand that not everyone has public code online.</p> <h1><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Own and deliver SRE projects end-to-end</strong> — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, rollout, and documentation</li> <li><strong>Serve as a technical anchor for the India SRE team</strong> — conduct design reviews, pair on complex debugging, and mentor engineers to develop the judgment to work through ambiguous problems independently</li> <li><strong>Design and implement infrastructure solutions</strong> across AWS (EKS, VPC, RDS, IAM, Cloud Watch, Cloud Trail, Guard Duty, S3, Cloud Front, Lambda, SQS) using Terraform and Cloud Formation, with an emphasis on making the right tradeoffs between speed, reliability, and cost</li> <li><strong>Lead Kubernetes operations</strong> including cluster upgrades, capacity planning, CNI troubleshooting, workload scaling, Helm chart packaging, and Git Ops deployments — and build the runbooks and automation so these become repeatable rather than one-off heroics</li> <li><strong>Evolve CI/CD pipelines</strong> across Jenkins (Groovy scripting), Git Hub Actions, AWS Code Pipeline, Argo CD, and Flux CD — with an emphasis on reducing manual deployment steps and improving rollback safety&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Drive observability stack enhancements</strong> — deliver the infrastructure and architectural direction necessary for engineering teams to leverage Prometheus, Grafana, and Cloud Watch effectively</li> <li><strong>Identify and execute Fin Ops initiatives</strong> — find zombie resources, right-size instances, enforce tagging standards, and present cost-reduction recommendations with data to back them up</li> <li><strong>Manage database reliability</strong> across My SQL and Postgre SQL including backup validation, performance tuning, replication health, failover testing, and operational runbooks</li> <li><strong>Strengthen security posture</strong> through IAM least-privilege enforcement, CSPM reviews, Guard Duty/Cloud Trail monitoring, secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Parameter Store), and audit readiness</li> <li><strong>Troubleshoot complex cross-cutting production issues</strong> spanning networking, Kubernetes, compute, databases, and CI/CD — and then turn the fix into a runbook or automation so the same issue doesn’t require the same person next time</li> <li><strong>Write the documentation the team actually needs</strong> — architecture decision records, operational runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and post-incident action items that get closed, not just filed</li> <li><strong>Collaborate daily with US-based SRE leadership</strong> on incident reviews, migration planning, roadmap execution, and platform strategy — bringing context and recommendations, not just status updates</li> <li><strong>Participate in on-call rotations</strong> and drive post-incident analysis with a focus on systemic fixes over individual blame</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1><strong>What will help you succeed:</strong></h1> <h2><strong>Must-haves:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>8–14 years of experience in SRE/Dev Ops/Cloud Engineering</strong>, with a demonstrated progression from task execution to project ownership — we’re looking for evidence that you have independently scoped, designed, and delivered infrastructure projects end-to-end</li> <li><strong>Deep, hands-on expertise with AWS</strong> — EKS, IAM, RDS, EC2, VPC, Cloud Watch, Cloud Trail, Guard Duty, Lambda, SQS. You should be able to architect a multi-AZ, multi-account solution and explain why you made the choices you made</li> <li><strong>Strong Terraform skills</strong> with experience managing complex, multi-environment state, writing reusable modules, and reviewing others’ Ia C for correctness and maintainability</li> <li><strong>Advanced Kubernetes knowledge</strong> — you don’t just deploy to K8s, you troubleshoot networking issues at the CNI level, tune resource requests and limits based on actual usage data, and can plan and execute cluster upgrades with minimal downtime</li> <li><strong>CI/CD pipeline design and ownership</strong> across Jenkins (Groovy), Git Hub Actions, Argo CD, or Flux CD — with a track record of improving deployment reliability and reducing manual steps</li> <li><strong>Observability stack experience</strong> with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent — including defining SLOs/SLIs, building meaningful dashboards, and tuning alerting to reduce noise</li> <li><strong>Proven mentorship ability</strong> — you have helped less experienced engineers grow. This could be formal (tech lead role, code review ownership) or informal (the person everyone goes to when they’re stuck). We will ask you about this in interviews</li> <li><strong>Strong written and verbal communication skills</strong> — you will interact with US-based teams daily, present proposals asynchronously, and write documentation that others can actually follow</li> <li><strong>Automation-first mindset</strong> — your instinct when you do something manually is to immediately think about how to script it. You have a track record of reducing operational toil through scripting and tooling</li> <li><strong>Incident management experience</strong> — you have led or significantly contributed to incident response and post-incident reviews in production environments, and you understand the difference between fixing the symptom and fixing the system</li> <li><strong>Ability to operate with autonomy</strong> — you don’t need daily direction. Given a problem space and constraints, you can propose an approach, pressure-test it with peers, and execute</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice-to-haves:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with Fin Ops practices — cloud cost analysis, rightsizing, tagging governance, reserved instance planning</li> <li>Exposure to secrets management platforms (Hashi Corp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager)</li> <li>Experience with event-driven architectures using AWS Lambda, Cloud Watch Events, SQS, and SNS</li> <li>Exposure to AI-enabled tooling (automation assistants, MCP, RAG pipelines, LLM-based debugging)</li> <li>Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake) and their operational requirements</li> <li>Experience with n8n or similar workflow automation platforms</li> <li>Industry certifications — AWS Solutions Architect Professional, CNCF CKA/CKS, Hashi Corp Terraform Associate, or equivalent</li> <li>Experience working in a company that has grown through acquisitions, with exposure to consolidating disparate infrastructure environments</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation based on market standards&nbsp;</li> <li>We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy</li> <li>Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits</li> <ul> <li>Flexible Leave Policy</li> <li>Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose</li> </ul> </ul> <ul> <li>We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)</li> <li>Flexible Benefit Plan</li> <li>Awards and Bonus</li> <li>Annual performance cycle</li> <li>Quarterly engagement activities</li> </ul> <p><a href="https://www.arcadia.com/assets/Engineering_Strategy_and_Values_V4.pdf">A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency</a></p> <p><strong><em>Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.</em></strong></p> <p>Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.&nbsp;</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Thank you</p></div>
